name: DROID_bench_all
description: DROID_bench_all is a collection of benchmark cases for evaluating analysis tools on Android applications, containing synthetic and real app samples with known behaviors (e.g., privacy leaks, API misuse). It is used to measure the ability of static/dynamic analysis and automated tools to detect security and privacy vulnerabilities in Android code and data flows.
evaluation_method: F1 (precision / recall) and accuracy (tool detection vs. ground truth), often complemented by per-case true/false positive/negative counts
reputation: Widely used in the mobile-security and program-analysis research community as a standard test suite for Android taint/vulnerability detectors.
